notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 127 from 21 January 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/27QaoJnY0M7c7Ikhz8CbUv?si=397188c406294fcf) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing bulky Minor adds in general, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with solar builds. Sojourner's Tale reprise has seen it a little neutered, losing trait perks that make a good burst damage weapon but it still has a niche role in clearing more difficult adds. At base, the stats are below average - 61 Range equates to 9.08m ADS and 7.57m hipfire, 40 Stability, 63 Handling is 0.33s ready, 0.30s ADS and 0.36s stow speed, and 44 Reload Speed is a 0.75s reload per shell. Magazine size is 6 (max 8), and with 0/1/2/3 Ammo Reserves mods you have total ammo of 19/21/23/23 (max 24). If you are in a market for a slug shotgun for burst damage, there is a niche roll that you might consider. Boost Handing with the barrel perk, and then in the magazine perk, Assault Mag improves fire rate, or Tactical Mag (with Backup Mag) maximises magazine size. If you're able to get a kill with another weapon before you start and proc Discord, you'll not need to worry too much about ammo reserves with every kill for 7s, either directly or via Incandescent's scorch and ignition (which you can improve with solar buildcrafting), generating ammo. The Splicer Surge origin trait is nice for PvE - reload after dealing damage for up to three stacks, which boosts handling and reload speed by 10/20/45 and applies a reload animation multiplier of ×0.967/×0.934/×0.9. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Firesprites or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Sojourner's Tale has never been popular for PvE but with the addition of Precision Instrument you can always have your shotgun topped off with Auto-Loading Holster and ready to go like FILO of old." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Sojourner's Tale has a cult-like following. Some people still main their Season 14 roll as it still puts in work.
